༄༅/ /chag med rnam bzhi gtsos pa'i dpal sa skya'i zhal 'don gces btus khag bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// chag med rnam bzhi gtsos pa'i dpal sa skya'i zhal 'don gces btus khag bzhugs so//

001 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul byin rlabs char 'bebs/ sga ston ngag dbang legs pas mdzad pa/ 002 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i char 'bebs/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ 003 rigs gsum spyi dbang gi brgyud 'debs ut+pal phreng mdzes/ wa gan+d+ris sbyar ba'o// 004 bya ba spyi rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rigs gsum bdag po'i sgrub thabs grub gnyis ut+pa la'i phreng ba/ wā gīn+d+ra su sidhas mdzad pa/ 005 rigs gsum spyi'i bdag bskyed/ 'di sgrub btus rjes gnang gi cho ga srid zhi'i dge legs lhun grub ces bya ba las phyung ba'o// mkhyen brtse dbang pos mdzad pa/ 006 sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ tshar chen gsung*/ 007 sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi nyams len snying por bsdus pa nag 'gros bklags chog tu bkod pa/ kun blos mdzad pa/ 008 nye brgyud tshe rta zung 'brel gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'chi med rdo rje'i glu dbyangs/ mkhyen brtse dbang pos mdzad pa/ 009 bla ma zhi khro'i tshe sgrub kyi cho ga 'chi med rdo rje'i rgya mdud/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa la kha skong mkhyen brtse dbang po'o// 010 gsung ngag rin po che brgyud pa gsum 'dus kyi bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa lam rim smon lam dang bcas pa/ blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ 011 rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ bir+wa pa'o// 012 lam 'bras a seng don bsdus/ sa chen gyis mdzad/ 013 lam zab tshar gsum khug pa rgyun khyer nyams su blang tshul sngags 'chang dbang po'i snying nor/ ngag dbang legs pa'i gsung*/ 014 dam tshig rdo rje'i sgrub thabs sdig sgrib kun 'joms/ kun blo'i gsung*/ 015 bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi nyams len/

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtshos gsung*/ 016 bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnal 'byor 'dod rgu lhun grub/ wa gin+d+ras mdzad/ 017 mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ wa gin+d+ras so// 018 tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i rdo rje'i glu byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang pos mdzad pa/ 019 bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyung ngu bsam 'phel/ gzim 'og sprul ming ya sha'i mtshan can gyis mdzad/ 020 lam zab phyi ma'i nyams len shin tu bsdus pa byin rlabs mchog stsol/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang pos mdzad pa/ 021 dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gyi mchog /zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi// nyams len gsang ba'i nye lam bzhugs// bla brgyud ngor chen gsung*/ gzhan dkon mchog lhun grub gsung la sde gzhung sprul skus mchan can no// 022 lam zab nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa la ngag chos kyi mchan bu can no// 023 lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs brag phug pas mdzad pa kha skong dang bcas pa/ 024 dpal ldan sa skya pa'i lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bzhi'i nang tshan lam zab phyi nang sbrags ma'i nyams len thun mong ma yin pa/ lce btsun dge 'dun bkra shis dpal 'byor gyis mdzad pa/ 025 dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa'i yan lag drug pa smin grol dngos grub rab 'phel/ ā ming pas sbyar ba'o// 026 dpal kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang dang bcas pa smin grol dngos grub rab 'phel/ ā ming pas sbyar ba'o// 027 gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa/ kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa/ 028 dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'bring du bya ba yan lag drug pa'i mdzes rgyan/

dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad/ 029 lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mdor bsdus/ bco brgyad mkhyen brtse'i ming can gyis mdzad/ 030 bla ma dgyes pa rdo rje yi// sgrub thabs nyung ngu rnam gsal 'di// blo gsal lam gyi sa mkhan te// yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal sbyin bzhugs// bco brgyad khri ming su bha ṣi tas mdzad pa/ 031 kyai rdor lam dus ma nor don gsal/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas mdzad pa/ 032 dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa man ngag gi snang ba/ bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa/ 033 dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung*/ 034 rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun khyer ngag 'don bklags chog tu bkod pa/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ 035 'di ni lus dkyil dang bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa med pa'i rgyun khyer rgyas pa'o/ ༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun khyer ngag 'don bklags chog tu bkod pa/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ 036 mkha' spyod lus dkyil/ 037 mkha' spyod man ngag thob pa yin na bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa bsgom tshul/ 038 nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ 039 nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa shin tu bsdus pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ 040 bsdus pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgom par 'dod pas/ bco brgyad khri chen gyis mdzad pa'o// 041 rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos man ngag kun gyi nying khu thugs dam nyams bzhes chag med rnam bzhir grags pa las bir srung phyi ma/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa/

042 rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa'i srung ba thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis dang*/ zhal bskong blo gros rgyal mtshan nam gzim 'og a nan+tas/ 043 bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len bya tshul bar chad g.yul rgyal dang*/ bstod pa/ lha btsun mkhyen dbang dang*/ rong ston chen pos sbyar/ 044 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang khrid kyi rgyud 'debs bzhugs/ bco brgyad pa lha btsun su bha ṣi tas so// 045 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug gi sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don zur bkol/ mdzad pa po zhal mi gsal/ 046 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba/ btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ 047 slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang dbyer med pa'i lam zab nyams su len/ tshul tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/ 048 rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs nges don thig le/ sa skya pa kun blos sbyar ba'o// 049 rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs sa bskang nang bzhugs pa ltar ro// 050 khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i brgyud 'debs dang sgrub thabs tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa kun blo'i gsung ngo*/ 051 dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs/ bla brgyud dpal ldan don grub kyis dang*/ sgrub thabs btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'o// 052 dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'o// 053 thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chen pos yum la gnang ba'i 'pho chos*/ mtshams sbyor dang bcas pa mkhyen rab byams pas gsung*/ 054 rong ston chen po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis gsung*/ 055 tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i gsol 'debs/ btsun pa blo gsal gyis mdzad pa/

056 tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i nyams len gyi rim pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len/ btsun pa blo gsal ming can no// 057 gu drag rgyun khyer dregs pa zil gnon kun las rnam rgyal/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: 058 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor phyag rgya gcig pa bzhugs// pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis bris pa'o// 059 rje btsun bir+wa pa'i srung ba'i man ngag bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ngor lugs so// dge slong bsam gtan pas/ 060 gsung ngag rin po che brgyud pa gsum 'dus kyi bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa lam rim smon lam dang bcas pa bzhugs so// nā len+d+ra'i brgyud pa ltar na/ tshar chen gsung*/ 061 dpal kyai rdo rje'i lam dus 'bring po'i nyams len blo gsal bde 'jug mdzad pa po mi gsal yang nā len+d+ra'i phyag gsol ltar dbang bsdus pa len tshul lags/ 062 dpal sa skya'i gdung sras rat+na badz+ra rin po che'i bzhed dgongs bzhin btus pa'i zhal 'don khag bcas bzhugs so/// / ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
